description:
Top 3 Skills:  
 6+ years of core J2EE development experience utilizing EJBs, Entity Beans and Swing*
 6+ years of experience developing client-facing web applications utilizing Swing* and Struts frameworks
 6+ years of experience deploying J2EE web applications on WebLogic Application Servers 
 *If lack of Swing experience is ruling out too many potential candidates, a developer is strong in Struts, WebLogic and EJBs will be considered 
   Requirements: 
 • Extensive Application Development work experience using Java.(1.4 and 6)
 • Solid design, coding, testing and debugging skills.
 • Solid knowledge of design patterns and UML 
 • Knowledge of version and revision control practices and procedures (SVN preferred)
 • Hands on experience with J2EE components such as EJBs, Entity beans, JMS, Web Services , XML, SOAP
 • Hands on experience with Weblogic Application Server (11g preferred)
 • Extensive SWING and STRUTS experience
 • Solid SQL programming knowledge (IBM DB2 a plus)
 • Ability to performance tune Java/J2EE applications, prefered
 • Experience with JNI and multi-threaded Java programming preferred.
 • Solid experience using Java development tools such as Eclipse, Ant etc.
 • Experience with java application integration to external devices such as barcode scanners label printers and other peripherals
 • Solid ability to analyze and translate use case based requirements into Design (UML), using design patterns
 • Knowledge of integrating Java based systems with Material Handling Equipments (MHE), and conveyer systems preferred. 


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration:  6+ Months 
 Phone+F2F
